key_insight: BoT-GRPO improves GRPO by aggregating token-level rewards with length-invariant weighting, giving more efficient process supervision without needing a value network.
engineering_relevance: The method is a drop-in RL upgrade for reasoning models that can speed convergence and improve final quality in code generation and math tasks when token-level rewards are available.
method: Collect token-level rewards from all rollouts.
Weight each token reward by the inverse length of its source sequence to form a bag-of-tokens aggregate.
Compute per-token advantages from weighted group statistics in a critic-free GRPO-style update.
evidence_signal: On React code generation it reached 80% compile rate up to 1.9× faster than GRPO, and on AIME it improved Pass@k by up to 8.1% over GRPO in half the steps.
watch_item: The approach depends on having reliable token-level reward signals, so noisy or unstable reward models can limit gains.
paper_title: BoT-GRPO: Efficient Process-Reward RL for Reasoning via Bag-of-Token Aggregation
